sql: select w.contact_name, w.remote_jid, i.unit, i.instance_id, w.ai_mode, w.bot_enabled, w.bot_step, w.lead_id, l.status as lead_status, l.origem, w.created_at from wapi_conversations w left join wapi_instances i on i.id = w.instance_id left join campaign_leads l on l.id = w.lead_id where w.id = '7b3143e0-4ad6-44ac-a9ef-077192e2745d'
